title: Refit water pump, AOS, accessories, intake and exhaust manifolds

notices.text: Metal-impeller water pump, new thermostat, all new AOS hoses, new injector O-rings, new exhaust manifold gaskets and nuts with anti-seize on the studs. Fit all sensors and route the harness exactly as photographed at teardown. Fit new spark plugs and inspect the coils — 20-year-old coils on a freshly rebuilt engine is a false economy.
